title_en: Andhra Pradesh water position: reservoirs, rain, groundwater and village tanks
title_te: ఆంధ్రప్రదేశ్ నీటి పరిస్థితి: జలాశయాలు, వర్షం, భూగర్భ జలం, ఊరి చెరువులు
why_it_matters_en: People hear that dams are full or empty, that rain failed, or that groundwater went up. These are the state water department's own daily and monthly numbers, with dates, so anyone can check.
why_it_matters_te: ప్రాజెక్టులు నిండాయి, ఖాళీ అయ్యాయి, వర్షం పడలేదు, భూగర్భ జలం పెరిగింది అనే మాటలు వింటాం. ఇవి రాష్ట్ర జల వనరుల శాఖ స్వంత లెక్కలు, తేదీలతో. ఎవరైనా సరిచూసుకోవచ్చు.

caveats_en: Each reservoir has its own reading time (as_on). Some readings are a few hours old.
District names are as served by APWRIMS on the 28-district map (for example 'Markapuram', 'Konaseema').

The 'outside_ap' group is reservoirs in other states (Karnataka, Telangana, Maharashtra) that feed AP rivers. Tungabhadra dam is served inside the 'major' group with district 'Vijayanagara(KS)', which is in Karnataka.
Values are copied as the API serves them, with all decimals. The website rounds them for display.
Basin names are as served (for example GODAVARI, Krishna, PENNAR, Other).
caveats_te: ప్రతి జలాశయానికి సొంత కొలత సమయం ఉంది. కొన్ని కొలతలు కొన్ని గంటల పాతవి.
జిల్లా పేర్లు 28 జిల్లాల పటం ప్రకారం ఉన్నాయి.
'outside_ap' అంటే మన నదులకు నీరు ఇచ్చే పక్క రాష్ట్రాల జలాశయాలు. తుంగభద్ర డ్యాం కర్ణాటకలో ఉంది.
సంఖ్యలు ప్రభుత్వ వ్యవస్థ ఇచ్చినట్లే ఉన్నాయి. వెబ్‌సైట్ వాటిని సంక్షిప్తం చేసి చూపుతుంది.

caveats_en: Only readings stamped on the asked date or the next morning are kept. Up to about 2020 the system stamps a day's reading at 06:00 the next morning. Each value keeps its own time in as_on_by_unit.
Coverage is thin before late 2015 and again in 2016 to 2019. Few reservoirs reported in those years. Do not read a missing reservoir as empty.
Capacity and district names come from today's master list. Some reservoirs did not exist or were not monitored in early years.
caveats_te: అడిగిన రోజు లేదా మరుసటి ఉదయం కొలతలే ఉంచాం. ప్రతి సంఖ్యకు సొంత సమయం ఉంది.
2015 చివరి వరకు, 2016 నుంచి 2019 వరకు చాలా జలాశయాల కొలతలు లేవు. కొలత లేదంటే జలాశయం ఖాళీ అని కాదు.
జిల్లా పేర్లు ఈ రోజు జాబితా నుంచి వచ్చాయి.

caveats_en: USE WITH CARE. APWRIMS adds up whatever reading it holds for each reservoir. For some dates (2016 to 2020 especially) that includes readings from weeks or months away. The note on each point says how many readings were same-date.
Totals are only comparable across years from about 2021, when nearly all reservoirs report daily.
Total design capacity is today's figure for every year.
caveats_te: జాగ్రత్తగా వాడండి. కొన్ని సంవత్సరాల మొత్తాల్లో వేరే తేదీల కొలతలు కలిసి ఉన్నాయి.

Band labels ('Full', '75 %', '50 %', '25 %', '0 %', 'Others') are the website's own column headers. The exact band limits are not printed.
'TOTAL' row is the state figure as served.

refresh.cadence: Daily for reservoirs, bulletin, rainfall and tanks. Run after about 11:00 IST: most reservoir readings land between 06:00 and 10:00 IST and the 20 Oct bulletin PDF was created at 10:09 IST. Groundwater monthly, when latestGWDataTp changes.
refresh.notes: No login, no key, no cookie needed. robots.txt is not present (the path returns the app page). Dates must be yyyyMMdd; a date like 2026-10-21 returns {"status":"permission denied"}. State uuid 6f86292b-dd9a-4987-bb8f-c3940263b349 is AP_UUID in the app bundle. Paths were read from main.a4c735408d4ac0d5.js and its lazy chunks on 2026-10-21; if the bundle hash changes, re-read the apiKeyName to path map. Space calls 1 to 2 seconds apart. The reservoir "current" can be stale for some reservoirs (one was from 29 July on the read date), so always store eventGenTs with the value. Scripts used: fetch.sh (modes today, history, daily), fetch_rf.sh, build.py, verify.py, finalize.py in this folder.

gaps: Reservoir history is thin in early years. On 1 June 2014 only 4 of 34 major reservoirs have a same-date reading, and 2016 to 2019 have gaps. Daily data is solid from about 2021.
The 1 June 2014 snapshot is one day before the state split (2 June 2014). It is kept as the nearest start-of-water-year date.
The daily series covers the 34 major-group reservoirs only, from 1 June 2026. Medium reservoirs and earlier years can be pulled with the same call.

The Inflow/Outflow bulletin archive on APWRIMS starts on 30 July 2026 only. The monsoon daily bulletin archive ends on 31 December 2024. The monsoon outlook (a forecast, newest 10 September 2026) was not captured because it is not a measurement.
Minor irrigation tank storage is mostly stale: 36337 of 38625 tanks were not updated in the field app in the last 30 days on the read date. It cannot show today's tank position.
Rainfall is captured for the 1 June to 21 October window each year only. Full-year totals, the October to December rains and daily rain are not captured yet.
Rainfall and groundwater history use the 28-district names even for years before those districts existed. The old 13-district figures are not served by these calls.
Groundwater for October 2026 and the November 2026 post-monsoon reading were not out on the read date.
No reservoir-wise figure for drinking water supply or irrigation area served is captured.
